label: Banco Central do Brasil - SGS (séries temporais)
terms_note: Open data, no key. Documentation in Portuguese (each SGS series' page on dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br describes the same call: https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.{codigo}/dados?formato=json&dataInicial=dd/mm/aaaa&dataFinal=dd/mm/aaaa). Dates in and out are dd/mm/aaaa; values are decimal strings with a dot. Live 2026-10-01 (beyond the dataset pages): a daily series without dataInicial answers HTTP 406 {"error":"O sistema aceita uma janela de consulta de, no máximo, 10 anos em séries de periodicidade diária"}; an unknown series code answers HTTP 200 text/html 'Requisição inválida!'.

error_kinds.note: daily series need a window of at most 10 years (dataInicial)
unknown series code: a 200 HTML page

get_series.note: series_id is the SGS code: 433 (IPCA, monthly %), 1 (USD/BRL PTAX selling, daily), 11 (Selic, daily %), 432 (Selic target). Daily series REQUIRE start, and start..end may span at most 10 years. start/end are YYYY-MM-DD.

not_offered.search_symbols: SGS has no search API (the series catalogue is the web interface https://www3.bcb.gov.br/sgspub/).
